name: Gordon Chompski
source: A cunning and practical dwarf who owns a store in downtown Dale. He's not a bad guy despite his sullen appearance. He raises his daughter, half-dwarf and half-fairy Willow, alone and takes great pride in her. He loves fish pies and is always ready to hire anyone as a fisherman.
